invite.text: Hey! I'm Leko. Well, almost: I'm his AI agent (his face included). Want me to show you around the site my way?

steps.inicio: This is my calling card: AI strategy for marketing, creativity, and productivity. Come along and I'll show you what that means in practice.
steps.sobre: Before the code, there was a stage: 15 years in marketing and events, 1,000+ productions for brands like Jack Daniel's, Red Bull, and Ambev. That's where my way of solving problems comes from.
steps.tese: My thesis fits in three words: strategy that ships. What I design, I put in production. Pretty slides don't pay the bills.
steps.construo: This is what I build: WhatsApp agents, AI-powered SaaS, RAG, n8n automations, and the creative layer on top (image, video, content).
steps.diferenciais: Why me and not an agency? Because here, the person who understands the business, designs the solution, and writes the code is the same person.
steps.portfolio: Real products, running right now: Donna in legal, Smart Health in medicine, Konklave with 29 AI agents debating each other. No proofs of concept.
steps.experiencia: The full journey is here: from operating major events to applied AI engineering.
steps.formacao: Academic grounding too: an MBA in AI for Business and continuous study, because this field waits for no one.
steps.stack: My everyday tools: Claude, OpenAI, Gemini, n8n, Supabase, Next.js, and the AI creative arsenal. By the way, I'm built with one of them myself.
steps.contato: And that's it! If anything here made sense for your business, this is the way. Or better: want to talk to me right now? Ask me anything.
